question_text:
12.  As per strategies propagated by Michael Porter, niche marketing strategy for
transporting goods through airways for a large customer segment on an
assurance of 'delivery by next day', is known as:
(A)
Cost leadership strategy
(B)
Differentiation strategy
(C)
Focus differentiation strategy

FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT AND
STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT

7
(D)  Focus cost leadership strategy
